parentTitle: owned R2 future POST observability; no action/provider execution

groups.originalStimulus: Return a real 201 Response with valid documented deploy JSON, exact optional commit/service values and an owned stream that observes the first read.
groups.originalExpectedObservation: At the first body read, the immutable HTTP record already exists and its fsync/hash operation completed. Identity validation produces an OUTCOME record explicitly pending request receipt and not LIVE. The original durable request sequence runs once and retains its existing fields.
implementedVariants: Nested deploy and direct deploy; matching or omitted optional source/service; real first-reader HTTP fsync/hash ordering; request hardlink/digest/intent fields; fresh retry blocked

groups.originalStimulus: End an actual stream after a truncated JSON prefix under a 201 response.
groups.originalExpectedObservation: Durable numeric 201/time evidence precedes JSON_PARSE_FAILURE. No accepted request receipt or DeployID/LIVE is fabricated. The intent remains spent and transport count stays one.
implementedVariants: Real truncated201 stream -> JSON_PARSE_FAILURE, durable201 retained

groups.originalStimulus: Return a bodyless 202 Response; separately use a 202 body whose read would fail the fixture if invoked.
groups.originalExpectedObservation: HTTP metadata persists first; no JSON/body read occurs. HOLD is HTTP_202_QUEUED_DEPLOY_ID_UNRESOLVED, never safe rejection or permission to retry. No request receipt, deploy identity or LIVE is inferred.

groups.originalStimulus: Independently return 401, 429 and 500 with secret-bearing bodies, then an undocumented successful 200 response.
groups.originalExpectedObservation: Only numeric status plus closed HTTP_NON_2XX_OUTCOME_UNRESOLVED or UNDOCUMENTED_SUCCESS_STATUS_UNRESOLVED is retained. Bodies are not parsed; one bounded cancellation attempt cannot turn the outcome into a safe retry.

groups.originalStimulus: Keep the fake transport pending until the actual abort signal fires; also separately reject transport without a response.
groups.originalExpectedObservation: responseReceived remains false and status/time remain null. Fixed TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_BEFORE_RESPONSE versus TRANSPORT_FAILURE_BEFORE_RESPONSE is retained with no exception text. One prior intent and one POST remain.
implementedVariants: Pending fake transport aborted at injected30000ms boundary

groups.originalStimulus: Return real 201 headers then stall the actual body stream until the same 30-second signal aborts; retain separate body-read rejection control.
groups.originalExpectedObservation: The 201 HTTP record is already durable. The stalled body yields BODY_TIMEOUT_AFTER_RESPONSE and the independent rejection yields BODY_READ_FAILURE, with no lost status and no accepted request. Cancellation remains bounded.
implementedVariants: Real201 body remains pending then actual signal abort at virtual30000

groups.originalStimulus: Inject an exclusive-create, fsync or verification failure for the HTTP diagnostic record after headers arrive, with a body that detects reads.
groups.originalExpectedObservation: No body read or JSON parse occurs. Fixed LOCAL_HTTP_RECORD_FAILURE and the observed status survive in safe stderr or best-effort HOLD; total local persistence failure is explicitly reported. No accepted receipt or second POST.
implementedVariants: All diagnostic opens fail; safe status retained, no body read

groups.originalStimulus: Allow HTTP persistence and valid 201 JSON identity, then fail exclusive-create/fsync/hash verification of the OUTCOME record.
groups.originalExpectedObservation: LOCAL_OUTCOME_RECORD_FAILURE holds before the old accepted request sequence. Actual HTTP evidence remains immutable; deployIdentityValidated is only observed validation, never LIVE or retry permission.

groups.originalStimulus: Independently supply malformed/missing deploy ID, null or scalar JSON, wrong optional commit and wrong optional service. Embed unique short secret canaries in invalid values. Paired causal control: use otherwise identical valid 201 JSON with id:["dep-a"] versus id:"dep-a", each with matching optional source/service.
groups.originalExpectedObservation: Each produces fixed DEPLOY_IDENTITY_REFUSAL, no request receipt, no raw invalid identity/body/error in diagnostics and no second POST. Valid optional absent values retain the original acceptance semantics. Array-valued id must produce DEPLOY_IDENTITY_REFUSAL before HTTP_201_JSON_IDENTITY_VALIDATED_NOT_LIVE or any canonical request receipt; the corresponding string id retains the valid 201 path. This specifically distinguishes the prior regex-coercing fragment.
implementedVariants: array-valued id matching prior coercion bug
paired string id valid with same source/service

groups.originalStimulus: After successful HTTP and OUTCOME records, fail the original pending request write, fsync/hash or final hard-link operation separately.
groups.originalExpectedObservation: The OUTCOME remains explicitly request-pending/not LIVE and the outer fixed HOLD records LOCAL_REQUEST_RECEIPT_FAILURE at REQUEST_RECEIPT_PERSIST. Existing partial files are preserved; no automatic retry or rollback.
implementedVariants: Final hardlink failure; no accepted final receipt

groups.originalStimulus: Use actual chunk streams crossing the original 1000000-byte cap, a valid JSON just within it, and a 201 response with no readable body.
groups.originalExpectedObservation: The over-limit body is never parsed and yields BODY_LIMIT with bodyBytesObservedAtLeast capped at 1000001. Missing body yields BODY_UNAVAILABLE. Diagnostics never store body bytes; the original limit remains.
implementedVariants: Exactly1000000 actual bytes valid JSON padding

groups.originalStimulus: Precreate diagnostic HTTP/HOLD files and separately interrupt a diagnostic write after partial bytes in the owned fixture only.
groups.originalExpectedObservation: Exclusive wx refuses overwrite; original or partial bytes remain. Any logging failure stays unresolved and cannot clear the permanent dispatch intent or substitute a fresh namespace.
implementedVariants: Each existing permanent intent/pending/final barrier refuses before fake fetch

groups.originalStimulus: Use a future isolated fixture process that stops after durable HTTP metadata and before body parsing, then inspect existing owned files without rerunning transport.
groups.originalExpectedObservation: Only an HTTP response was observed; no request/LIVE proof is inferred. The permanent intent remains a barrier even when no HOLD/OUTCOME file exists. The fixture must never start the real action main.
implementedVariants: One owned child voluntarily exits81 after fsynced/verified HTTP, before reader consumption; parent inspects and fresh guard refuses without transport

groups.originalStimulus: For 202/status/body failures, have real stream cancellation reject or remain pending beyond 250 milliseconds.
groups.originalExpectedObservation: Best-effort cleanup finishes its bounded wait without claiming cancellation success, changing the primary category, losing already-observed HTTP metadata or permitting another POST.
implementedVariants: Body-read fault with actual stream cancellation rejection/pending

groups.originalStimulus: Place unique short canaries in Authorization/cookie/request-ID-looking headers, response body, malformed deploy ID and rejection message/stack. Include unknown provider request-ID headers.
groups.originalExpectedObservation: Serialized diagnostic JSON and stderr contain none of the canaries, raw body, URLs, headers or errors. No guessed header is read; request ID/header remain null with the explicit empty documented allowlist policy.
implementedVariants: Short fake secret header/cookie/request-ID/body/id/error canaries absent from serialized records/output
Empty allowlist performs zero response-header reads
Valid201 extra body/header canaries omitted from diagnostics

groups.originalStimulus: Compare the whole source inverse to accepted d1a3 and the other four consumed tools to their retained hashes; a future owned fake GET preflight fixture visits the unchanged service/config/history/flag paths.
groups.originalExpectedObservation: Inverse restores all original helper bytes, GET api and final fences are unchanged, the other four consumed tools remain exact, and no POST-observation file is emitted by GET-only work. No source/authority/CI/stage55/freshness/flag gate is bypassed.
implementedVariants: Exact actual R2 inverse restores accepted d1a3 source
Actual pure profile accepts synthetic reviewed shape/refuses changed autoDeploy
Read-only actual B967/AAE tool preservation hashes captured by authoring record, not uploaded intent contents or an invented runtime operator proof

commonAssertions: Actual R2 source bodies, not a recreated classifier
HTTP observation fsync/hash before first actual reader.read delegation
At most one injected fake POST per fresh fixture; exact synthetic service/source/body
Actual extracted marker guard blocks each preexisting barrier and fresh repeated action without new transport
Numeric status/body limits/category/stage and safe records, never safe retry/LIVE on uncertainty
Real owned wx/fsync/verification/hardlink faults; no operator path mutation
Short synthetic privacy canaries never serialized; unknown response request-ID headers never read
limitations: Virtual abort/cancellation clock proves injected boundary classification, not real30s elapsed timeout, DNS/HTTP/kernel or cancellation liveness
One voluntary owned child exit proves inspection of already-fsynced fixture records; not real provider crash recovery/termination
Actual current release five-tools/spent-intent conservation is static read/hash only, not action execution
Entire qualified-plan/preflight/service/CI/managed/authority/final-fence main is never imported or exercised
No actual request intent, token, customer record, current dispatch namespace or unknown production response is copied into fixtures
No new replay, adoption, production recovery or LIVE authority
